gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-syloti-na: Nordic spaces its closed, single-weight letters like brush dabs set far apart, giving everything an ancient, powerful presence. The real draw is how Noto Sans Syloti Nagri opens up beneath it.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac rounds out into glassy lowercase bowls and wide, easy s turns, modern and approachable. Nordic stamps out closed, monoweight headings, while the body handles the quiet talking.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-syriac-ea: Dense and ancient up top, Nordic crowds its openings shut and keeps one monoweight stroke throughout. But Noto Sans Syriac Eastern keeps its curve endings well apart, and that openness is the pair's whole appeal.

gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Nordic keeps a steady, unvarying weight from word to word, with closed-up shapes and wide-set spacing. Noto Sans Tai Viet then carries running text smoothly, its modest ascenders and lofty x-height keeping lines compact.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Nordic is closed-up and ancient, drawn in a single monoweight stroke. Beneath it, Noto Sans Tamil Supplement opens its round, parenthesis-like forms on a stocky line, giving the heading's tight shapes some breathing room.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Round letters with a wide, inviting opening and short ascender stems make Noto Sans Tangsa the welcoming half of this pairing. Nordic, closed and monoweight, supplies the powerful punch up top.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-tc: Generous open counters let Noto Sans TC breathe, its curves turning outward rather than curling inward on themselves. Beside that openness, Nordic feels closed, ancient and powerful, a heavy counterweight.
